packageRules.description: Each gtk-rs binding and its -sys companion must move in one update. The lockfile-only updates Renovate raises for these transitive crates bump a single entry, and a binding compiled against a stale -sys does not build: gio 0.22.9 against gio-sys 0.22.0 fails with 'cannot find type GDBusActionGroupClass in crate ffi'. Grouping them keeps the pair in one branch so the build result is real before the update lands.
